customParts.question: Do you manufacture custom parts according to technical drawings?
customParts.answer: Yes. Manufacturability and pricing can be evaluated based on a technical drawing, sample or application scenario.

prototype.question: Do you provide prototype and sample production?
prototype.answer: Yes. Depending on the project geometry, tooling requirements and target quantity, prototype or first-part production can be carried out before serial production.

weldingThreading.question: Are welding and threading operations performed in-house?
weldingThreading.answer: Yes. MIG, TIG, spot welding and threading are among our in-house manufacturing capabilities.

partnerProcesses.question: How are laser cutting, sheet metal processing and spring manufacturing managed?
partnerProcesses.answer: These processes are carried out through our approved solution partners under MBA Metal's project coordination.

coating.question: Are coating processes performed in-house?
coating.answer: No. Coating is not performed in-house. The appropriate surface treatment is coordinated with our solution partners according to project requirements.

minimumOrder.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
minimumOrder.answer: The minimum quantity depends on the geometry, tooling requirements, number of processes, material and surface treatment requirements.

secondaryStory.title: Not every project starts with a technical drawing.
paragraphs: Sometimes a manufacturing request begins with a completed technical drawing. In other cases, we may only have an existing sample, a product image, basic dimensions or an application requirement that needs to be solved.

We therefore begin by understanding where and how the component will be used. We then evaluate criteria such as geometry, material, manufacturing method and required quantity to determine a practical manufacturing approach.

productionApproach.title: From technical requirements to controlled manufacturing.
productionApproach.description: We approach every project as more than a component to be produced. We treat it as an integrated process in which technical requirements must be understood, manufacturability evaluated and production managed in a controlled manner.
